items.title: Loss and Damage Fund approves $20 million grant for Nepal’s flood recovery
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 23 The Loss and Damage Fund, established to address climate-related losses and damages, has approved a $20 million grant for Nepal to support relief, rehabilitation and reconstruction in communities affected by devastating floods in the Bhotekoshi and Trishuli river basins. The Ministry of Agriculture, Forests and Environment announced the decision in a statement […] The post Lo

items.title: Loss and damage fund approves $20 million for Nepal
items.summary: The funding is intended to help flood-hit communities in the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli region recover and rebuild.
